[DAY4 17:02:01 - DAY4 17:02:24]
I turn and walk into the room and follow Shure as he comes out holding a guitar. "Yes," I say. He sets his phone on the desk, walks toward the umbrella, pulls a chair into place and kicks it, then sits with his legs crossed and puts the guitar on his lap. I cross my arms and walk under the umbrella; "我靠," I say. Nicous chats with him while Katrina listens nearby. Shure takes out his phone and scrolls with his right hand as his left plucks the guitar.

[DAY4 17:00:00 - DAY4 17:03:00]
I begin by moving to the side of the table, picking up the power bank, and unplugging the data cable. I hand the power bank to Tasha, who connects the cable and plugs it into my glasses. She then puts the power bank in her pocket and takes out her phone, while I open a box, grab another data cable, and head outside to the yard where friends are relaxing under an umbrella. I place the data cable on the table and return inside.

I search the bedroom thoroughly, feeling along the bed but do not find the item. Returning to the living room, I pick up the power bank from the power strip and unplug it again. Holding the power bank, I move toward the door as Tasha enters and chats with me. I look around, point to the kitchen, and Tasha locates the item there. I then head outside holding the power bank.

Outside, I walk through the entrance into the yard under the umbrella, where Shure and Nicous are on their phones and Katrina is chatting with them. I instruct, “You need to plug it in. You need to turn it on.” I then turn back into the house, ascend the stairs, pass through the entrance hall, and re-enter the living room where Alice and Tasha are seated at the table; Tasha grabs a bag of snacks.

Carrying a charger, I go into the bedroom, place it on the table, touch my nose, and cross my arms. I pick up the power bank again and return outside. Alice pulls out a chair, and I sit holding the power bank before walking to the yard and standing under the umbrella. Nicous remains on his phone; Shure picks up a phone from the table and stands, while Katrina adjusts her glasses, tidies her belongings, and picks up her bag.

While slowly walking around the yard with the power bank, I look at it and ask, “What’s this?” Tasha answers, “Mint leaves.” I repeat, “Mint leaves,” noting their presence. I engage in brief conversation with the group, look around the yard, and clap my hands as I turn around in the relaxed setting.

I then walk into the room, turn toward the eaves, and cross my arms as Shure comes out carrying a guitar, placing his phone on the table. I follow him to the edge of the umbrella, watching as he pulls a chair, sits, places the guitar on his lap, and strums with his left hand while navigating his phone with his right. Nearby, Nicous chats with Katrina listening, and I affirm with “Yes.”

[DAY3 22:45:00 - DAY3 22:45:30]
"Okay," I say. Lucia replies, "Mm-hmm, thank you." Lucia walks in. I hand Lucia the chopsticks. Lucia says, "I said this pair doesn't look unused." Lucia adds, "I rinsed them." Tasha walks in. "Oh," I say. Lucia asks, "Uh, what are you doing?" "It's so hot!" I exclaim. I talk to Tasha. I push my glasses up. I eat the meat. Lucia says, "Ah, finally ate it." "It's just a little hot," I note. I walk outside. Katrina gets up. Shure is still looking at the tablet and then starts playing the guitar.
